newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair's SAC sees higher 1996 profit.
newsitem.headline: Swissair's SAC sees higher 1996 profit.

text.p: Swissair Associated Companies (SAC), a wholly-owned company of the Swissair Group, expects to raise its operating profit this year to 160 million Swiss francs from 1995's 142 million, a company spokesman said.

SAC's sales this year will stagnate at around 1.9 billion francs but then jump to over three billion in 1997 as Allders International is integrated into SAC's unit Nuance Holding, which is active in duty-free business.
Swissotels, the hotel chain owned by Swissair, will also report a profit this year, the first time in many years, on the back of improvements in the U.S., he added.
